title: Allow env-configured replay measurement sources
user_business_goal: Let the HMI/replay endpoint run the same shadow inspection flow against configured sanitized replay, product spec, and calibration artifacts so boundary-derived measurement fixtures can be exercised through /inspection/replay without hardcoding the default replay sample.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
request-supplied file paths for replay/spec/calibration selection
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: /inspection/replay reads replay manifest, product specs, and calibration paths from env-only configuration when provided.
Env vars are optional and default to existing checked-in bootstrap fixtures.
Env-configured boundary replay fixture returns derived length/width/diagonal measurements through /inspection/replay.
Request-supplied paths or query strings are not used for replay/spec/calibration selection.
Endpoint remains no-camera/shadow-only and all phase production_authority values remain false.
Docs/tests describe env-only replay configuration and do not approve production release, live camera, product specs, QC/SOP tolerance, or model promotion.
required_checks: HTTP preview smoke for /inspection/replay with FLANGE_QC_V2_REPLAY_MANIFEST_PATH=samples/replay/flange_qc_v2/phase2_synthetic_boundary.json when local preview is available

memory_preflight.query: FQV2 env-configured replay source for boundary-derived measurements.
retrieved_decisions: Boundary/corners measurement derivation exists and remains shadow-only.
Request-supplied artifact paths are rejected in detector flows.
App runtime configuration should use env-only paths.
retrieved_lessons: HMI should exercise sanitized fixtures through normal endpoints without introducing request path injection.
Replay source selection must preserve no-camera/shadow-only production authority rules.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is separate; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-049 PR to restore /inspection/replay to default checked-in fixtures only. Existing replay, HMI, boundary measurement, product tolerance, and product CI behavior remain valid.
